title: Identification of bioactive compounds and molecular targets of Fuke Huahuang formulation to treat vaginitis.
authors: Liu, Huiyu; Mo, Jie; Liang, Cheng; Chen, Qingting; Yang, Bin; Liu, Jiaqi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方治疗阴道炎的活性成分与靶点，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Fuke Huahuang formulation (FHF) is widely used in the treatment of vaginitis, with clinical evidence indicating its promising anti-inflammatory properties. METHODS: We explored the bioactive components and potential mechanisms of FHF for treating vaginitis, and reveal its pharmacological activities against vaginitis. RESULTS: A total of 12 anti-inflammatory components in FHF and 584 pharmacological targets were identified. Furthermore, 1427 vaginitis-associated targets were identified, and 184 intersection targets between FHF and vaginitis were constructed for network analysis. Gene Ontology and pathway analysis revealed that the therapeutical targets of FHF against vaginitis are involved in modulating inflammatory stress, enhancing immunoregulation, reconstructing the microenvironment, and suppressing cell damage. Molecular docking analysis further suggested the possible direct binding of the bioactive compounds of FHF (fumarine) to the core targets, including AKT Serine/Threonine Kinase 1 (AKT1), Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3 (STAT3), and nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB). Experimental validation found that FHF-treated vaginitis rats exhibited reduced intracellular AKT1, STAT3, and NF-kappaB protein expressions. CONCLUSION: Overall, we identified the bioactive compounds and pharmacological mechanisms of FHF against vaginitis, thus offering a theoretical fundament for exploring FHF for treating vaginitis in the future.
abstract_zh: 背景：妇科花黄制剂（FHF）广泛用于治疗阴道炎，临床证据表明其具有前景的抗炎特性。方法：我们探索了FHF治疗阴道炎的生物活性成分和潜在机制，并揭示了其抗阴道炎的药理活性。结果：共鉴定出FHF中12种抗炎成分和584个药理靶点。此外，鉴定出1427个与阴道炎相关的靶点，并构建了FHF与阴道炎之间的184个交集靶点用于网络分析。基因本体论和通路分析显示，FHF抗阴道炎的治疗靶点涉及调节炎症应激、增强免疫调节、重建微环境和抑制细胞损伤。分子对接分析进一步表明，FHF的生物活性化合物（富马碱）可能直接结合核心靶点，包括AKT丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶1（AKT1）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）和核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）。实验验证发现，经FHF治疗的阴道炎大鼠表现出细胞内AKT1、STAT3和NF-kappaB蛋白表达降低。结论：总体而言，我们鉴定了FHF抗阴道炎的生物活性化合物和药理机制，从而为未来探索FHF治疗阴道炎提供了理论基础。
